description: Design system overhaul - upgrade the color palette, typography, shadows, and global CSS to a premium modern SaaS aesthetic with vibrant gradients, refined spacing, and polished dark mode
steps: Update artifacts/resume-matcher/index.html to load Inter (variable weight 300-800) alongside DM Sans, and add Inter Display or Plus Jakarta Sans as a display font alternative for headings

Overhaul artifacts/resume-matcher/src/index.css: (a) Replace the muted gray-blue primary palette with a vibrant indigo-violet primary (e.g., 245 82% 67% for primary) that signals modern SaaS energy, (b) Add an accent gradient from indigo to purple/pink for CTAs and highlights, (c) Upgrade shadows to use layered shadow stacks with color for depth (e.g., shadow-lg with primary-tinted layers), (d) Refine dark mode to use richer contrast with slightly elevated card surfaces and subtle border glow, (e) Add CSS custom properties for gradient backgrounds: --gradient-primary, --gradient-hero, --gradient-surface, (f) Add utility classes: .text-gradient-primary (indigo to violet bg-clip), .surface-elevated (subtle gradient bg for card surfaces), .border-glow (border with subtle glow in dark mode), .animate-gradient (animated gradient background), (g) Improve typography scale: heading letter-spacing, line-height fine-tuning, body text optimized for readability at 15-16px

Update artifacts/resume-matcher/src/components/ui/button.tsx: (a) Upgrade the 'default' variant to use the new vibrant primary, (b) Make 'gradient' variant use the new indigo-to-violet gradient with a subtle shimmer on hover, (c) Add ring animation on focus that pulses briefly, (d) Ensure all buttons have smooth 150ms transitions for scale/shadow

Update artifacts/resume-matcher/src/components/ui/card.tsx: (a) Add a 'premium' variant with subtle gradient border (1px gradient border effect), (b) Upgrade 'elevated' to have layered shadows and slight background gradient, (c) Add subtle hover border-color transition to all cards, (d) Make glass variant more refined with stronger blur and softer opacity

Update artifacts/resume-matcher/src/components/ui/badge.tsx: Add a 'subtle' variant with very light background tint and matching text color (useful for status indicators), ensure the gradient badge uses the new vibrant gradient
acceptance_criteria: Build passes with pnpm --filter @workspace/resume-matcher run build
Typecheck passes with pnpm --filter @workspace/resume-matcher run typecheck
The CSS file contains new gradient variables, upgraded shadow system, and vibrant color palette
Button, Card, and Badge components have new variants and improved styling
findings: Build passes successfully. Typecheck has pre-existing errors (api-client-react not built, implicit any in pages) that exist on main without changes. No new type errors introduced by this feature. The index.css was fully rewritten to incorporate all new design tokens.
